body: from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor, ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed  # * 启动并行任务[ThreadPoolExecutor:线程池; ProcessPoolExecutor:进程池]
description: 引入 concurrent.futures 启动并行任务

body: """# ThreadPoolExecutor - 多线程：IO密集型任务（网络、文件、等待外部程序）
**创建 ThreadPoolExecutor 线程池实 例对象 executor**
futures = [executor.submit(fn, *args, **kwargs)] : fn 参数是要执行的函数, *args 和 **kwargs 是 fn 的参数
results = [] : 使用空列表接收线程运行结果 -> [results.append(future.result()) for future in as_completed(futures)]
futures = [executor.submit(do_work, i) for i in range(5)]
"""# ProcessPoolExecutor - 多进程：CPU密集型任务（计算、循环、解析、音视频图像处理）
**创建 ProcessPoolExecutor 进程池 实例对象 executor**
futures = [executor.submit(fn, *args, **kwargs)] : fn 参数是要执行的函数, *args 和 **kwargs 是 fn 的参数
results = [] : 使用空列表接收线程运行结果 -> [results.append(future.result()) for future in as_completed(futures)]
futures = [executor.submit(do_cpu_work, i) for i in range(5)]
